title: Kagamine Len — My Own Way Of Being Cool!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: My Own Way Of Being Cool!（3★）
meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, I'll make this line stand out more and make this one a little blurry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Len, are you still working on your drawing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just getting into a good groove.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Look at you having so much fun! After you said that drawing is childish or whatever♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: G-Gimme a break...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, how's your drawing coming along?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow...! Your guitar looks so cool now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. Your attention to detail is incredible. It's obvious that you're doing everything you can to make it look as cool as possible.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I know right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: After putting so much effort into drawing this guitar, I really want to play it now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I mean, this is SEKAI.
Isn't it possible for this guitar to appear if I really wish it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if you wished really, really, really hard?! Would that make it appear?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I figured...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way, Len, are there any other things that you think are really cool?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Let's see... Oh, definitely rock music!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! Listening to rock songs is fun, but playing them yourself makes you sound really cool, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I really love songs that have good bass action!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I kinda want to actually learn more about why rock is rock. Right now, I'm sorta playing it superficially...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, is there anything other than music that you think is really cool?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something other than music? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, motorcycles and staying up really late...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I understand motorcycles...
But staying up late?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because I see myself staying up late playing my guitar and drinking coffee that I normally wouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How cool is that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... I've had coffee before, but prefer tea or juice because it was too bitter.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how you feel, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, I also understand the allure of staying up late while playing my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When it was just me and Luka here, I spent some nights up on the rooftop playing ballads while stargazing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's exactly what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! In that case, Len, why don't you try drawing all of those?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A-All of them...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet your drawing is gonna turn out super cool if you do!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
Well, I did want to draw more, so maybe I'll give that a try...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, I'm done.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You playing a rooftop rock concert...
With motorcycles and coffee, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, I drew what you suggested and... What in the world's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... I was sure that you drawing everything that you thought was cool would turn your drawing into something spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But there seems to be too much going on here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: To be fair, I had a feeling this would happen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, but... When I asked KAITO about learning how to draw better, he mentioned something about “less is more”...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which means my drawing might actually become better after subtracting a few of these things.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: First, I have to think about how I want it to look cool... Motorcycles go perfectly with rock, so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len's gone straight back to drawing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. He must be really enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'd rather not interrupt him, so why don't we go somewhere else to practice?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Show us how your drawing looks later, okay, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure.
